RunningSubagents.note: Three running subagents on the ComposerPopoverSurface the chip actually opens: title, status/model/background/duration meta line, GitFork glyphs. Correct spacing.

SingleAgent.note: One-row roster with a truncating long description — the truncation is the component's own contract.

NoActiveSubagents.note: Roster fed only completed/failed subagents renders the 'No active native subagents.' empty copy, which is the locked design (finished agents leave the roster immediately).
